news.body:
## Waiting on you
Locus exit is due tomorrow and still has nothing on record: no resignation date, no notice period, no last working day. It is the only Critical thing with a date this week, and the HelloFresh handover is waiting behind it. What is the last working day you are actually aiming for?
The SBI Global Ed-Vantage sanction letter is Critical, due 24 October, and has not moved. Sanctions take weeks at the bank's end rather than yours, so the question is whether anything is still outstanding from your side.
## Worth starting
Campus France has your corrected preconsular file back as of yesterday afternoon and EEF validation now reads 21 October. Nothing to do while they check it, but it is the gate on the VFS appointment, so a week of silence from them is worth chasing rather than waiting out.
